summary: On June 7 and 8, 2026 an unauthorized actor accessed a database of Preferred Parking Service, a Charlotte, North Carolina operator of parking lots and garages in 15 Southeast cities, and obtained customers' names and credit card information. State filings showed about 5,200 South Carolinians, 142 Massachusetts residents and 11 Vermonters affected, with the North Carolina count not disclosed. The company said it had added security measures.
